title: ناخن شماره ۹: از پا تا اوج
format: Third episode but a new genre: heartwarming underdog story + glow-up makeover (Pixar-like warmth with comedy). Keep the cinematic bars/grain look from 02/03 but warmer. Built as ONE continuous 'camera journey' with match-cut portals through objects (sock hole, door, mirror-like shine). Beat-synced montage at 100 bpm for the glow-up. High motion: orbits, whip-pans, rack focus, parallax, speed ramps, squash-and-stretch. Cute, never scary.
goal: Emotional + shareable. 34-42 s. 1-second hook, glow-up transformation as the wow moment, a 'tag someone' CTA, and a tease for episode 5 (Number 10).

cast.name: Number 9
cast.desc: giant sleepy toenail blob, tiny sock hat, huge gentle eyes; after glow-up: glossy lilac with a gem

cast.name: Number 7
cast.desc: tiny pink almond-nail blob with a bandage

cast.name: Ducky
cast.desc: rubber duck in the spa with a sly wink and a tiny towel

cast.name: Fans
cast.desc: colorful fingernail blobs with tiny glow-sticks and cameras

scenes.idea: Dark cozy sock cave, one dust-lit ray from a hole high above. Camera creeps in on Number 9, the giant sleepy toenail blob in a tiny sock hat, hugging his knees, a single sad blink. Through the hole, glimpses of bright fingernails getting compliments. Slow dolly-in, soft piano feel.

scenes.text: شماره نُه خسته بود... خسته از تو جوراب بودن
scenes.idea: Split-screen/parallax montage: upstairs, glossy fingernails get hearts, camera flashes and a coffee-mug photo shoot; downstairs Number 9 gets only lint and a dangling thread. Hearts float up past him and don't stop. He tries to wave, nobody sees. Camera tilts up and down between the two worlds.

scenes.text: پس یه تصمیم گرفت: بیرون زدن!
scenes.idea: He stands up with determination, cracks his knuckles (cute), runs and headbutts the sock toe; fabric rips in slow-mo with threads flying; MATCH CUT: the camera flies through the hole like a portal into the next scene. Speed lines, screen shake.

scenes.text: از لابه‌لای کفش... تا رسید به یه جای عجیب
scenes.idea: One-take illusion: camera tracks beside Number 9 as he rolls and bounces like a ball through shoe-world: lace bridges, insole trampoline, sandal-strap swing, dropping down a staircase; clumsy comedy, camera whip-pans on each bounce, dust trails, ends with a door he crashes through.

scenes.text: آب گرم، سوهان، و یه کم ناز
scenes.idea: Door bursts open to a bright pastel spa: warm foot-bath with bubbles, steam, soft ring light. A rubber-duck sidekick winks and points at the bath. Number 9 dips in, ahh face, foam hat, tiny sponge scrubs, file sparks like glitter. Warm color grade shift from cool blue to peach. Slow orbit.

MOTION MAX beat-synced glow-up montage, a hard cut on each word: base coat sweep, lilac color wipe, sparkle gem pop. Final spin transformation: 360-degree orbit with a light-sweep reveals Number 9 glossy, lilac with a gem and a huge specular shine, star glints, camera flare.

scenes.text: و برای اولین بار... همه برگشتن نگاش کنن
scenes.idea: Catwalk on a sunny beach boardwalk: Number 9 strides in slow-motion wearing tiny sandals, crowd of fingernails (Number 7, Number 8, Gel, many colors) turn their heads, flash photography, confetti, parallax palm trees; camera tracks low and then cranes up. Wind in the sock hat.

Emotional beat: close-up on Number 9, a happy tear and a smile, hearts bubbling up around him; slow pull-back reveals the whole foot with a ring-light halo and sparkles; the sock hole is patched with a little heart patch. Quiet, warm, rack focus.

scenes.text: ولی یه سایه‌ی بزرگ‌تر داره میاد... شماره ده!
scenes.idea: Sudden rumble: the sunny sky darkens, a giant shadow slides across the beach; the camera tilts up to a huge thumbnail blob silhouette blotting out the sun, thumbs-up pose, lens flare behind. Title sting. Everyone gasps, sand shakes, waves recede.

scenes.text: تگ کن اونی رو که ناخن پاش رو نادیده می‌گیره
scenes.idea: All the nails and the duck line up and point at the viewer; Number 9 winks and shows a sparkling shine; quick match-cut loop back to the dark sock cave of scene 1, now with a heart patch; end-card @ayda.nailroom.
